font.reason: Vazirmatn (variable 100-900) is the neutral Persian product-UI sans: reliable joining, Persian digits, ZWNJ coverage, multiple real weights; it matches the command-palette/product-dashboard world of both demos. Loaded only where copy exists: PaletteThemeRipple wraps with FaFonts; ThemeSweepToggle has zero visible text, so its pointless FaFonts wrapper was REMOVED this round (reviewer minor issue).

fixes.issue: major: detached caret - fixed minWidth:168 on the typed-query cell put the blinking cursor ~140px left of the typed word
fixes.action: Removed minWidth; the text cell is now shrink-wrapped, so in the RTL flex row the caret sits directly LEFT of the last typed letter (the RTL typing end), mirroring the original's caret-after-last-block. Verified in renders: f38/f54/f68 show the caret hugging the word; blink cadence (every 8f) unchanged so fa and orig blink states coincide.
fixes.why: A caret must sit at the typing point; a fixed-width cell only made sense for the original's fixed 30px blocks.

fixes.issue: major: lost pop beat - original had four 30px blocks scaling in with back(2.2); the Persian word was 28px, low-contrast, opacity-fade only, reading incomplete at f62-65
fixes.action: Kept the word (the query is real copy worth translating) but rebuilt the beat: the visible text is ONE prefix-sliced shaped run ('تیره'.slice(0, typedCount)) at 38px / weight 600 / G.ink on the white card, and the whole run pops with the original Easing.out(back(2.2)) from scale 1.16 to 1 over 4f on each cue frame (38/46/54/62). Per-letter transform boxes were NOT used because inline-block breaks Persian joining (kit rule 1c); the run-level pop preserves the hit while prefix slicing preserves shaping. Verified: f38 shows the new letter landing large at the caret, f40 settled; the word is complete and high-contrast from f62.
fixes.why: Motion fidelity: each of the four typing cues must still read as a hit with overshoot, not a fade.

fixes.issue: minor: header comments lacked per-element reasons and mixed original Chinese notes with the localization header
fixes.action: Rewrote both headers in English with an explicit per-element decision list and reasons (sweep polygon mirror x -> 1920-x, bright-line rotate sign flipped to -15deg so it stays on the clip edge, scaleX(-1) mirror justified by the textless skeleton, ripple origin radial/symmetric so unchanged, settle scale unchanged). Translated ALL remaining Chinese inline comments; a CJK scan confirms zero Chinese characters in both files.
fixes.why: Header comments are the permanent record; reviewers flag mixed or reason-free headers.

fixes.issue: minor: ThemeSweepToggle loaded Vazirmatn 'though no visible copy' - pointless FaFonts wrapper
fixes.action: Removed the FaFonts wrapper, the _fa import, and the fontFamily/direction from the root div of ThemeSweepToggle. Re-rendered f20/f30: identical correct mirrored sweep (sidebar right, dark theme entering from the right edge, bright edge line on the clip boundary).
fixes.why: A font wrapper with zero visible text is dead weight plus a needless delayRender.

fixes.issue: minor: scaleX(-1) mirror of the fixtures dashboards undocumented
fixes.action: Documented in both headers: the skeleton is textless gray geometry (no glyphs anywhere), so a mirror is visually identical to relaying it out RTL and keeps the light/dark layers pixel-aligned so the sweep reads as the same UI re-skinned. The light layer is dimmed+blurred and conditionally unmounted once the ripple completes, so the mirror never carries text.
fixes.why: Reviewer asked for the explicit note that mirroring (rather than RTL re-layout) is safe here.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated to «تیره», typed right-to-left on the ORIGINAL four cue frames (38/46/54/62, one letter each). Visible text is a single prefix-sliced run (typeOn-style), so shaping re-flows correctly at every frame (e.g. isolated ت at f38 gains its join to ی at f46). The whole run does a back(2.2) scale pop (1.16 to 1, 4f) on each cue. 38px, weight 600, G.ink.
rtlDecisions.why: Keeps the four-beat typing rhythm and the overshoot hit energy of the original blocks; per-letter transforms would need inline-block and break joining. Persian typing reads right-to-left, so the caret mirrors to the left of the word.

rtlDecisions.action: Cell is shrink-wrapped (no fixed width; flexShrink 0 on caret and badge); caret 4x40px sits immediately LEFT of the typed prefix; blink flips every 8f exactly like the original.
rtlDecisions.why: Caret must sit at the RTL typing end; a fixed-width cell only fits the original's fixed-size blocks and detaches the caret.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept unchanged as an LTR-isolated token (direction ltr + unicodeBidi isolate, Arial 800); in the RTL input row it sits at the RIGHT edge (reading start).
rtlDecisions.why: Keyboard notation is a universal Latin-direction token Persian UIs keep.

rtlDecisions.action: Both mirrored with scaleX(-1) so the sidebar and card reading order sit on the RTL side; DarkDashboard keeps pixel-identical geometry to FakeDashboard variant A.
rtlDecisions.why: Skeletons are textless, so mirroring equals RTL re-layout visually and keeps the two themes aligned for the in-place re-skin read. The light layer is dimmed+blurred, then unmounted at RIPPLE_END (true rest).

rtlDecisions.what: Panel, collapse point, flash dot, circular ripple and bright ring
rtlDecisions.action: All UNCHANGED: panel centered at ORIGIN (960,470), shrink 68-73 ease-in cubic, flash dot ~3f, circle 12-1250px ease-out cubic, 5px white ring with symmetric glow.
rtlDecisions.why: The panel is horizontally centered so the causal chain (shrink point = ripple origin at RIPPLE 73) stays exact; a circle and its ring are radial/symmetric - no reading direction to mirror.

rtlDecisions.action: All original constants preserved (DIM_START 15, PANEL_IN 22, TYPE_FRAMES 38/46/54/62, ENTER 68, RIPPLE 73, RIPPLE_END 95, MAX_R 1250, back(1.9) panel drop). Exported names and values unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: Motion fidelity; RTL did not require any timing change.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster assets. Both dashboards and the panel are CSS geometry with no baked-in text; nothing to blur or replace.
compositions.visualVerification: Viewed fa vs orig at f46 and f54 (caret + typed prefix, same blink states, pop mid-flight), f38/f40 (first letter lands large then settles; correct isolated-to-joined shaping), f62 (complete word, first result row darkened = selected, matching orig), f68 (caret on, shrink starting), f80 (ring mid-ripple), f169 (dark true-rest frame, no foreign text).

rtlDecisions.action: Both mirrored with scaleX(-1), sidebar on the right; identical textless skeleton geometry in both themes.
rtlDecisions.why: Rail/card order is reading-direction; mirroring is visually identical to RTL re-layout because there are no glyphs, and it keeps the sweep reading as the same UI re-skinned.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored horizontally: x -> 1920 - x (polygon 100% 0 / 1920-p 0 / 1920-p+SLANT 1080 / 100% 1080), so the dark theme enters from the RIGHT edge and travels toward lower-left. 15deg slant, poly(3) out easing, SWEEP0=14 / SWEEP1=52 unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The sweep direction carries reading-direction meaning; the slant angle and the timing are physical/temporal and stay.

rtlDecisions.action: x position mirrored with the same mapping (left = 1920 - p + SLANT/2 - 2) and rotation sign NEGATED: rotate(15deg) -> rotate(-15deg), so the 4px line + glow stays exactly on the clip polygon's slanted edge (top vertex 1920-p, bottom 1920-p+SLANT).
rtlDecisions.why: The line must track the mirrored clip edge; keeping +15deg would tilt it against the boundary.

rtlDecisions.action: Unchanged (1 -> 0.995 -> 1 over frames 52-64, cubic out; all palettes identical to upstream).
FaFonts wrapper REMOVED this round (no visible copy in this composition); the header now documents the omission deliberately.
rtlDecisions.why: Zero visible text - the wrapper was a pointless delayRender and the old header falsely claimed it set the Persian UI tone.

compositions.rasterHandling: No raster assets or visible text; both theme versions are CSS skeleton dashboards.
compositions.visualVerification: Viewed fa vs orig at f30 after the wrapper removal: mirrored sweep from the right, sidebar right, dark theme covering, edge aligned; identical structure to the previously verified render.

render.durationNote: The registry reports 95 frames for PaletteThemeRipple; the source design continues to frame 170. Used the harness --duration 170 for inspection stills (f169) and for the full Persian video render, without changing the registered duration or any frame constants.

leftovers: Grep confirms: no letterSpacing, no textTransform/uppercase, no fixed-width text cells, no per-code-point transform spans, and zero CJK characters in both card files. Persian copy uses ی/ک (never ي/ك); «تیره» needs no ZWNJ; Persian digits are not applicable (⌘K is the only token on screen and stays Latin by convention); Persian punctuation not applicable (no sentences on screen).
concerns: The card registry truncates PaletteThemeRipple at 95 frames even though its source timeline specifies a 170-frame dark hold. Inspection stills and the rendered video use the intended 170-frame timeline via the harness duration flag; registry metadata was left unchanged.

The whole-run pop means letters 2-4 briefly re-pulse the entire word on their cue frames rather than only the new letter scaling (a per-letter scale would break joining). Judged frame-by-frame as a faithful typing-hit rhythm; documented as an intentional adaptation.
ThemeSweepToggle's sweep timing was verified identical by the round-1 reviewer; this round only removed the font wrapper, and f20/f30 stills confirm nothing moved.
lessons: Command-palette/typing mocks: never give the typed-text cell a fixed minWidth - the caret must sit at the RTL typing end. Shrink-wrap the text cell; in a direction:rtl flex row the caret element automatically lands left of the prefix (the correct mirrored position) with no coordinate maths.

When a placeholder motif (per-character gray blocks with no literal text) is replaced by real Persian copy, rebuild the pop beat on the whole run: one prefix-sliced shaped string + a run-level back() scale pop on the original cue frames. Opacity-only fades read as a weaker beat, and per-letter transform boxes break joining.
Do not wrap textless compositions in FaFonts/FaRoot 'for tone': it is a pointless delayRender and reviewers flag it. Load fonts only where visible copy exists.
